items: Franchise reputation comes from everything guests experience, from food quality and wait times to listing accuracy, so running each location well is the foundation of a good reputation.
Reply to positive reviews within 24-48 hours using the guest's name and a specific detail, and handle negative reviews quickly and gracefully.
Track star rating, response rate, response time and sentiment for each platform and each location, because a strong portfolio average can hide one location dragging the brand down.
Treat reviews as an operations feed by tagging them by area, watching for repeated complaints and shift patterns, and sharing the trends with operations, kitchen and marketing teams.
